raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s instructions to open authoritative sources and extract the stated cause of death with citations. Instead, it only reported the DuckDuckGo results page and relied on an auto-generated snippet (mentioning lymphoma), without clicking into reputable obituaries (e.g., NYT, LA Times, NPR) that clearly state leukemia/complications from leukemia. This omission introduced unnecessary ambiguity and led to repeated, unproductive loops, preventing a definitive, sourced answer.
